title: Order the videos by speed
headerExplanation: First, watch the four videos and then order them by speed by dragging them. You can watch them as many times as you want.
selectionText: Press the start button after reading the explanation and entering your information.
explanation: In this exercise you will evaluate different systems that generate human animations. In each exercise, you will be shown 4 videos. You have to watch these videos, in any way you want, and you will be able to rewatch them any number of times.

Then, you will have to order the 4 videos from fastest to slowest. In other words, the animation with faster and more vivid movement should go on the most left, and then go slower and slower to the right, the most right one being the slowest.
To order the videos, you can click and drag them. After ordering the videos, send the response by clicking the send button on the bottom.
The test contains attention checks. In these attention checks, you will have to rank the videos as the check asks. If you fail more than one attention check, you will be disqualified.
Thank you in advance for spending time to complete this task. Your participation is very useful and important to us.
mainQuestion: Drag the videos to rank them from fastest (left) to slowest (right).
thankYouText: Thank you for participating in this exercise. Your participation is very useful and important to us.
feedbackLabel: Write your feedback here, and press the button
feedbackText: Finally, you can write any feedback that you seem to have about this exercise. This step is optional, you can close the window if you want.
